title: Remote Stats
glancesHint: SSH works, but the glances command was not found on %1. Install Glances on the server, then press Refresh.
glancesFailedHint: SSH works, but Glances on %1 failed. Run glances on the server to see the error.
timedOutHint: %1 or its Glances is slow or stuck. Remote Stats tries again at the next poll.
config.invalid: config.json is not valid JSON. The panel shows its last good version.
config.reason.name: no name
emptyText: Use Add server to configure your first server. Remote Stats connects over SSH and reads load, CPU, memory and disks from Glances every %1 s.
form.name: Name
form.err.format: Use host, user@host, host:port or user@host:port
form.err.user: User may only use letters, digits, . - _
form.err.hostChars: Host may only use letters, digits, . - _ (IPv6 in [brackets])
form.err.duplicate: %1 is already in the server list
hint.key: Use a key without a passphrase. The README shows how to make one.
hint.server: Check the host, port and network, then test again.
hint.hostkey: The host key of %1 changed. If you expect this, run ssh-keygen -R %1, then test again.
hint.auth: Add %1.pub to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of %2 on the server.
hint.glances: Install Glances on the server, then test again.
hint.glancesFailed: Run glances on the server to see the error, then test again.
hint.timedOut: The server or its Glances is slow or stuck. Test again in a moment.
